description.value: Coast Discovery Inn, affectionately known locally as 'the D.I.', is a full-service downtown Campbell River hotel situated directly across the street from the ocean. Part of the Coast Hotels chain, it has earned a TripAdvisor Certificate of Excellence and serves as a landmark within the downtown cityscape. Touring cyclists will find a convenient urban base with laundry services, free hot buffet breakfast, and on-site dining at D.I. Restaurant & Lounge, though no cycling-specific facilities are advertised.

address.value: 975 Shoppers Row, Campbell River, BC V9W 2C4

Restaurant & Lounge and a free hot buffet breakfast are also confirmed. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention any bike-specific amenities such as secure storage or cycling staff procedures, leaving both required WWC criteria as null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hotel is a well-established downtown Campbell River property with several amenities useful to touring cyclists (laundry, free breakfast, Wi-Fi, on-site dining), but neither required WWC criterion — secure bike storage and staff bike procedure — can be confirmed from available evidence.
